Intugle is a GenAI-powered platform that helps enterprise organizations to transform their legacy business processes and application into agentic applications

We are looking for an AI Engineer with hands-on experience building and deploying production-grade AI agents. You will design, develop, and operate multi-agent systems using the LangChain ecosystem (LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith), integrating LLMs, tools, memory, and external APIs to automate complex workflows.

* Design and implement single and multi-agent pipelines using LangChain and LangGraph, covering orchestration, state management, and tool use
* Build custom tools, retrievers, and memory modules to extend agent capabilities
* Integrate agents with external systems via REST APIs, MCP servers, and function-calling interfaces
* Implement RAG pipelines — from chunking strategy and embedding selection to vector store indexing and retrieval optimization
* Write and refine prompts; maintain prompt versioning and regression test suites
* Instrument agents with LangSmith (or equivalent) for tracing, evaluation, and latency profiling
* Deploy agents to cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure) using containerized services (Docker, Kubernetes)
* Collaborate with product and domain teams to translate business workflows into agentic solutions

Core Agent Engineering

* LangChain (chains, agents, tools, memory, callbacks)
* LangGraph (stateful multi-agent graphs, conditional edges, human-in-the-loop)
* Prompt engineering and structured output design
* Tool/function calling with OpenAI, Anthropic, or open-source models

LLM & ML Foundations

* Working knowledge of transformer-based LLMs and their API surface (context windows, temperature, sampling)
* Embedding models and similarity search
* Familiarity with fine-tuning concepts (LoRA, PEFT) — even if not hands-on

RAG & Knowledge Retrieval

* Vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector, Chroma, Qdrant)
* Chunking strategies, hybrid search, re-ranking
* Semantic layer design or ontology mapping (a plus)

Software Engineering

* Python (strong) — async patterns, typing, packaging
* REST API design and consumption
* SQL — ability to write and debug complex queries
* Git, CI/CD pipelines, environment management

Infrastructure & Deployment

* Docker and container orchestration basics
* Cloud deployment: AWS Lambda / ECS / EKS, or GCP Cloud Run, or Azure Container Apps
* Environment and secrets management
* Basic understanding of message queues (Kafka, SQS, Redis) for async agent pipelines

Observability & Evaluation

* LangSmith or equivalent tracing tools
* Evaluation frameworks for LLM outputs (LLM-as-judge, RAGAS, custom evals)
* Logging, alerting, and SLA monitoring for AI systems

Nice to Have

* Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) — building or consuming MCP servers
* Knowledge of Agent-to-Agent (A2A) communication patterns
* Graph databases (Neo4j) for semantic/schema retrieval
* AST-based code analysis or data lineage tooling
* Experience deploying on enterprise platforms (Azure ML, AWS SageMaker, Vertex AI)

The Associate AI Engineer sits inside a Customer Platforms and supports by orchestrating AI agents to produce code, tests, and documentation, ensuring features across Officeworks’ digital properties are built and maintained efficiently. **ongoing operation, maintenance, and support of Customer Platforms systems in production**
. This includes monitoring system performance and health, identifying and resolving production issues, supporting incident and defect resolution, and implementing fixes and enhancements to ensure the reliability, stability, and continuous improvement of digital platforms

* Run single or paired agent workstreams across coding, test generation, and documentation workflows.
* Translate technical and product specifications into precise, structured instructions for AI agents to execute.
* Apply platform context, base coding standards, and security policies to every agent execution.
* Monitor parallel agent tasks and confirm that generated outputs satisfy specified functional requirements.

* Log technical decisions and specification updates to maintain end-to-end trackabilities for system workflows.

* Participate in on-call support rotations as required to maintain platform reliability and system availability.
* Support release verification and post-deployment checks to confirm features perform as tested before hyper care handover.
* Track runtime anomalies or recurring defects and feed learnings back into context documentation and agent guidance.

Factori is the real-world data layer for enterprise AI. Our real-world intelligence platform connects business decisions and AI systems to aggregated physical-world signals through the Real World Graph.

  

We help enterprise teams bring external context into decisions about locations, markets and customers.

  

Our marketing team is building awareness and qualified demand among multi-location retailers and QSR businesses, starting with the US market.

**The role**

  

Make Factori's marketing website a reliable way for enterprise buyers to understand the offer and take the next step. You will build and maintain pages, improve performance, connect forms to the marketing stack and help the team ship conversion improvements quickly.

  

This is a hands-on web development and operations role, working closely with the Growth Lead, PMM Lead and SEO specialist.  
  
**What you will own**

* Build and maintain responsive WordPress pages, reusable templates and components for retail solutions, campaigns, customer evidence and resources.
* Translate approved designs and content into accessible pages with consistent navigation, clear calls to action and a usable mobile experience.
* Own marketing forms, confirmation states, scheduling links and CRM handoffs. Verify successful submissions, source capture, deduplication and recovery when an integration fails.
* Implement and validate analytics events and tags with growth colleagues. Distinguish successful lead submission from a button click, prevent duplicate events and respect consent settings.
* Improve page speed, Core Web Vitals and reliability. Diagnose rendering, caching, asset-loading and plugin issues using browser and monitoring tools.
* Implement SEO requirements, including redirects, canonicals, sitemaps, metadata, internal links and accurate structured data. Support migrations with a tested URL map and post-release checks.
* Maintain staging, version control, release checks and rollback procedures. Coordinate hosting, DNS, backups, access and security maintenance with engineering or IT owners.
* Run measured conversion improvements with the Growth Lead using form diagnostics, user feedback and analytics. Use controlled tests when traffic supports them.
* Implement and monitor A/B tests and other performance experiments to enhance website performance.

  

**Required AI knowledge and skills**

Practical knowledge of using AI in web development, maintenance and quality assurance workflows is required for this role.

* Proficiency with coding assistants such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot or equivalents for component development, troubleshooting and integration work.
* Understanding of how to review and validate AI-generated code for functionality, accessibility, responsiveness, security and performance, including protecting credentials and sensitive information.
* Ability to structure repeatable AI-assisted workflows for page creation, migration checks or site QA. Knowledge of staging, automated checks, human release review and rollback procedures.

* 1-4 Years experience maintaining a production marketing website and examples of pages or integrations you personally shipped.

In your first 90 days, establish a verified website and integration baseline, ship reusable retail and campaign templates, and close the highest-impact defects in priority conversion journeys.

  

We will assess successful form delivery, release quality, page performance, accessibility and publishing turnaround. Conversion improvements are shared with growth, PMM and SEO, and measured on prospect journeys rather than privacy-page traffic.

You will own a visible part of Factori's enterprise buying experience. The role combines web craft, marketing systems and practical AI-assisted development, with direct feedback from the people using the pages and the teams receiving the leads.

jobs.description:
**Job Summary**  

As a SoC Functional Validation Engineer, you will play an integral role in ensuring the quality and reliability of Intel's state-of-the-art System-on-Chip (SoC) solutions. In this position, you will define, develop, and execute validation plans for integrated SoCs, focusing on post-silicon validation, debugging, and optimization. Through collaboration with cross-functional teams, your contributions will directly impact the performance and functionality of Intel products, driving innovation and excellence in the industry.

  
  
**Business Group**  

The Data Center Group (DCG) is at the forefront of developing cutting-edge technologies that enable high-performance computing and data-driven solutions. DCG focuses on creating advanced products and systems that power cloud, enterprise, and AI applications. By joining our team, you will contribute to Intel's broader mission of providing world-class solutions that shape the future of technology and computing.

  
  
**Key Responsibilities**  

* Develop and execute post-silicon validation plans to ensure compliance with design specifications and requirements.
* Perform functional validation for integrated SoCs, focusing on IP integration, system-level features, and interaction between components.
* Collaborate with architects, RTL designers, firmware teams, and other engineering groups to understand system-level requirements and features.
* Design and implement directed and random test cases to validate hardware/software interactions and ensure functional coverage closure.
* Debug SoC failures, identify root causes, and implement solutions or workarounds as required.
* Utilize tools such as Python, C, or C++ for test development and automation scripting.
* Analyze and modify test results, adapt test codes, and address coverage gaps to improve validation accuracy.
* Prepare and track validation requirements in collaboration with firmware, hardware, and platform teams.
* Develop and optimize validation methodologies, tools, and automation frameworks to streamline testing processes.
* Participate in project meetings, provide regular status updates, and escalate critical issues to management and stakeholders.
* Contribute to the development of new validation tools and methodologies, offering feedback and technical inputs for improvement.

  
  
**Qualifications**  

Minimum Qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree in Electronics, Electrical, or Computer Engineering, or related field, with 0-1 years of relevant experience in validation, test development, or debugging. Alternatively, a Master's degree in the relevant field with no prior professional experience.
* Proficiency in Python, C, or C++ for test content creation and automation scripting.
* Strong understanding of computer architecture, microarchitecture, and operating system concepts.
* Experience with pre-silicon platforms such as emulators or Virtual Prototypes for test code development.
* Demonstrated ability to debug software and hardware issues, identify root causes, and provide effective solutions.
* Knowledge of system hardware/software validation techniques and methodologies.
* Familiarity with data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI) for reporting metrics and tracking progress.

  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**  

* Solid understanding of x86 architecture and its interactions with hardware and software components.
* Hands-on experience with silicon debug tools, failure analysis methods, or system-level validation infrastructure.
* Familiarity with AI-driven workflows or tools for test plan development and analysis.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with strong attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a cross-functional team environment.
* Enthusiasm for innovation and advancing validation processes through new methodologies and tools.

Work Model for this Role: This role will be eligible for our hybrid work model which allows employees to split their time between working on-site at their assigned Intel site and off-site.

  
  
**Job Type**  

Intel Contract Employee

  
  
**Shift**  

Shift 1 (India)

  
  
**Primary Location**  

Bangalore

**Job Summary**  

Join Intel as a Silicon Packaging Design Engineer, where you will be at the forefront of semiconductor innovation, driving the end-to-end development of cutting-edge substrate designs. In this role, you will perform substrate fit and routing studies to optimize performance, cost, and manufacturability while collaborating with customers and internal teams. Your contributions will directly impact the creation of Intel's advanced silicon packaging solutions, ensuring they meet electrical and manufacturing requirements.

  
  
**Business Group**  

At Intel, the Assembly and Test Technology Development (ATTD) Design group plays a crucial role in advancing the company's semiconductor packaging technologies. This team focuses on optimizing silicon-package-board performance, driving innovations in substrate design, and supporting Intel's overall mission of delivering world-class computing solutions. By joining this group, you'll be part of a collaborative environment that empowers innovation and technical excellence.

  
  
**Responsibilities**  

* Develop physical layout designs for silicon packages, assembly test chips, and Intel's EMIB (Embedded Multi-die Interconnect Bridge) technologies.
* Collaborate with customers and electrical engineers to optimize signal integrity and power delivery.
* Create bump patterns and placements while adhering to design rule requirements.
* Perform signal routing planning and power grid placement to meet electrical and manufacturing standards.
* Conduct various layout verification processes, including routing checks, connectivity validation, DRC (Design Rule Check), and electromigration analysis.
* Provide feedback on feasibility studies and implement customer enhancement requests.
* Resolve design and methodology challenges related to layout design tools and workflows.
* Document design processes and maintain collateral in product lifecycle management systems.

  
  
**Qualifications**  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a STEM-related field with 1-6 years of hands-on experience in silicon packaging design, demonstrated through academic projects, internships, coursework, or training OR a Master's degree in a related field with no prior professional experience.
* Proficiency in EDA tools such as Cadence or Siemens for package/PCB design.
* Familiarity with programming languages such as Python, Perl, Linux, and/or SKILL.
* Strong understanding of electrical field theories and electronic fundamentals.

  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**  

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Attention to detail and a customer-oriented mindset.
* Highly motivated and results-driven with a passion for innovation.

Take the next step in your career by joining our team of innovators who are shaping the future of semiconductor design.
